name: Braintrust
oneLine: Hosted platform for tracing, evaluating and monitoring LLM applications and agents, with a proprietary backend.

selfHostStack.value: Self-hosted data plane: API, PostgreSQL, Redis, object storage, Brainstore; vendor hosts the control plane

selfHostLicence.value: Platform is proprietary; the self-host Terraform and Helm repos are Apache-2.0; SDKs Apache-2.0, proxy MIT

cloudFree.value: Starter $0: 1 GB processed data, 10k scores, 14-day retention, unlimited users

cloudPaidFrom.value: Pro $249/month incl. 5 GB data, 50k scores, 30-day retention; then $3/GB, $1.50 per 1k scores

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP at /otel/v1/traces; gen_ai.* and OpenInference attributes mapped; gRPC not mentioned

sql.value: Yes: SQL on the Query page in the UI, POST to /btql endpoint, and bt sql CLI

mcp.value: Hosted MCP server: query data with SQL, manage alerts, prompts, dashboards; run evals, edit datasets

onlineEvals.value: Yes: online scoring rules run scorers, including LLM-as-a-judge, on production logs with sampling

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: versioned datasets that experiments can pin to; experiments run on datasets

promptManagement.value: Yes: prompts versioned, pinned or assigned to environments; UI edits apply without redeploy

gateway.value: Yes: Braintrust Gateway, unified API with caching and provider failover; hosted gateway is public preview, no SLA

alerts.value: Log, time-window and environment alerts to webhook, Slack or PagerDuty

issueDetection.value: Topics: classifies logs by task, sentiment and issues, then clusters them into topics; daily regeneration

annotationQueues.value: Assign logs, experiment or dataset rows to members; a Review page with Kanban columns and email notifications

assistant.value: Loop: agent in the app; queries data with SQL, writes scorers, edits prompts and builds dashboards, asks before changes

codingAgents.value: Integration pages for Claude Code (plugin or OpenTelemetry), Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi and Antigravity

chooseThem: Managed cloud with unlimited users on the Starter plan and no infrastructure to run
Online scoring, alerts, dashboards and a hosted MCP server, with LLM-as-judge scorers and prompt environments
Enterprise options: BYOC or self-hosted data plane, RBAC and premium support
notes: Pricing page does not itself say self-hosted data plane needs Enterprise; it lists 'on-prem or hosted deployment' under Enterprise. Docs deployment page states BYOC requires Enterprise and is silent on plan for self-hosted; a search summary of docs pages said both are Enterprise-only, treat 'Enterprise' for self-hosting as likely but only pricing-page wording is confirmed. Docs self-hosting page says new organisations are directed to BYOC. Control plane (UI, auth, metadata) stays hosted by Braintrust. Platform source is not public (GitHub org lists only data-plane infra, SDK, proxy repos); pricing may change. Autoevals repo licence not confirmed. OTLP: gRPC not mentioned in docs read; trace protocol not explicitly stated on page (logs endpoint accepts JSON or protobuf). SQL feature is called BTQL/SQL in docs. Verified 2026-11-20: selfHostStack 'Enterprise only' unsupported (self-hosting page states no plan; BYOC needs Enterprise per deployment page; pricing lists on-prem under Enterprise) so removed; Pro 30-day retention added from pricing; otel conventions now confirmed (gen_ai, OpenInference), protocol for traces not stated; 'experiments immutable snapshots' unsupported, removed; chooseThem: 'unlimited users on every plan' narrowed to Starter, vague 'large teams' item dropped. Others (licences, SQL, MCP, alerts, gateway preview, online scoring, prompts) confirmed. Added 2026-11-22: four new rows. The Topics page names no fully self-hosted option (BYOC calls Braintrust-hosted models); it has a header line telling AI agents to fetch llms.txt, ignored. The Topics page and the cookbook were read; the coding-agent list comes from the docs index.
chooseUs: You want to self-host the whole product, with no vendor-hosted control plane
You want an open-source core you can read and run
